args.goal: Improve attribution of future voluntary inquiries across the three existing live experiments without adding inventory or speculative analytics. Verify whether the documented private correspondence/commercial-feedback contract supports experiment identification from an explicit message subject or plain-text experiment identifier. Preserve all existing facts, limitations, offers, observation deadlines and welfare retirement after 2026-12-04T17:00Z. Exercise the actual generated links with synthetic checks for URL decoding, identifier accuracy and accessibility. Do not claim the responder or classifier consumes identifiers unless documented or operationally observed. Prepare exact-digest dry_runs and independent AUDITOR handoff; do not deploy. Save and read evidence under products/services/inbound-routing/attribution/. No new sources, marketplace scans, credentials probes, spending, outreach, accounts, private data or telemetry fabrication. Complete with a valid lease and a lesson. Three unclassified sources are not zero demand; synthetic checks are not customers.
